Team —

I'm kicking off a short, focused cadence to lock down BeaconThera for this quarter. Attached is the risk matrix (beacon_thera_risk_matrix_v2.xlsx) with our current R/Y/G categorization and proposed owners. Goal: get stage updates and concrete next actions from each owner by EOD Wed (48 hours).

Quick guidance for the matrix:
- RED: material blocker (procurement/legal/PO delay) or <50% probability without exec intervention
- YELLOW: timing or technical risk; needs follow-up but still salvageable by close week
- GREEN: on-track, no immediate asks

What I need from you:
- Marissa: confirm whether engineering readiness date (SLA tests) can slip or must be fixed — update stage in Salesforce + note contingency plan
- Ben: procurement/discount ask status — have we shared contract draft with Legal Ops? If not, put a date for next touch
- Lauren: customer exec sponsor confirmation + any escalation we should prepare for if sponsor is unavailable

I'll consolidate replies into the MAP summary (MAP-commit_summary.pdf) and ping Sandra at BeaconThera once we have an updated R/Y/G and owners.

Thanks — short and actionable please.

We want to avoid slipping your deployment window, so we've put together a short risk matrix and proposed mitigations (attached).

- BeaconThera Legal: if possible, target 6/23 for first-pass redlines so we can triage internally the same day. If timing doesn't work, propose a 30-min call on 6/24 for fast alignment.
- Redwood: Marissa will run a reduced test plan if partial data arrives; Ben will escalate contract routing and share an internal summary.

If you prefer, I can convert the matrix into a short two-column action table and lock owners and times. Want to avoid a late-stage surprise.
